title: Lapata Purge
description:
A Minecraft Spigot plugin that starts a timed ritual when a player head is placed on bedrock, showing a floating hologram countdown with particles.
When the timer ends, it creates a big explosion with totem effects and removes the head automatically.
body:
**LapataRevived is a custom Minecraft Spigot plugin that adds a dark ritual system triggered by placing a player head on bedrock. When activated, a floating hologram countdown appears with animated particles above the ritual, creating a cinematic effect. Players can control the ritual duration using the command **
```
/head time set <value> <seconds/minutes/hours>.
```
** Once the timer finishes, a powerful explosion and totem-style particle burst are triggered, sounds play, and the ritual head is automatically removed — making it perfect for SMP events, magic mechanics, and custom gameplay experiences.**

Special Thx to - **Niz Gamer**
